>>Q<< REVERSE GEAR SLEEVE INSTALLATION
1. Make sure the synchronizer ring, reverse gear and needle 
roller bearing have been correctly installed.
2. Using special tools MD998812, MD998818 <F5M42>, 
MD998820 <F5M51> and MD998364 <F5M51>, press fit 
the reverse gear sleeve. Make sure that the reverse gear 
and the synchronizer ring can rotate freely during the 
pressing process.
